sections.markdown:
## B — Signals, roundabouts, railroads and markings
Audience: first-time Montana non-commercial Class D applicants studying signals, roundabouts, railroads and markings.
Level: introductory rule retrieval; the ordered handbook section is the coverage basis, without any invented official examination weight. Prerequisites and confusable topics: The previous section on signs, work zones and school zones; the distinction between steady and flashing signal displays, and between white same-direction and yellow opposing-traffic lane lines.
This is a research handoff. Read physical pages forty through forty-five as ordinary signal, roundabout, railroad and marking guidance. Signal-head diagrams are carried only through the extracted text descriptions. Posted lane controls that vary by time or place remain debt until the displayed control is confirmed.
